# Petfood

> Daily AI-assisted intelligence on the pet food industry: market, M&A, regulation and innovation news from trade press, with per-article summaries and a daily briefing.

Content is in English. Articles are collected every two hours from public RSS feeds (trade publications and news searches) about the subject above; summaries and the daily briefing are AI-generated, and each item links to its original source.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/petfood-watch/): articles of the last 30 days with the daily briefing
- [Archive](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/petfood-watch/archive/index.html): one page per month, all articles

## Machine-readable

- [Atom feed](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/petfood-watch/feed.xml): 50 latest articles
- [JSON data](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/petfood-watch/data.json): briefing and articles from the last 30 days
- [Sitemap](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/petfood-watch/sitemap.xml)

## Categories

- 📈 Market
- ⚖️ Regulation
- 💡 Innovation
- 🤝 M&A

## Sources

- [Petfood Industry](https://www.petfoodindustry.com/): Global reference media: trends, investments, innovations.
- [GlobalPETS](https://globalpets.org/): Distributors, retailers, international markets.
- [FEDIAF](https://europeanpetfood.org/): European regulation, nutrition, statistics, sustainability.
- [Pet Food Processing](https://www.petfoodprocessing.net/): Plants, automation, CAPEX, supply chain.
- [All Pet Food](https://en.allpetfood.net/): Manufacturing technologies, ingredients, processes.
- [Waltham Petcare Science Institute](https://www.waltham.com/): Scientific reference of Mars Petcare.
- [Global Pet Industry](https://www.globalpetindustry.com/): Global news: consumer trends, M&A, retail.
- [Mars Petcare](https://www.mars.com/petcare): Official announcements, investments, ESG.
- [Royal Canin](https://www.royalcanin.com/): New products, ESG commitments, digital initiatives.
- [Purina](https://www.purina.com/): New products, research, AI initiatives.
- [Hill's Pet Nutrition](https://www.hillspet.com/): New products, pet nutrition science.
- [Freshpet](https://www.freshpet.com/): Fresh pet food, growth, expansion.
- [Mars Petcare (Google News)](https://www.mars.com/petcare): Press review: announcements, investments, ESG, Mars Petcare innovations.
- [Royal Canin (Google News)](https://www.royalcanin.com/): Press review: new products, research, Royal Canin digital initiatives.
